summary: The old damerau_levenshtein computed restricted optimal-string-alignment distance, returning 3 instead of 2 for "ca" → "abc". The fix preserves that algorithm as osa_distance and adds unrestricted Damerau-Levenshtein using character-position tracking. Blocked: swapping in the parent function violates changed-line provenance because its body survives unchanged in osa_distance. Reversing the enclosing changes would remove OSA APIs required by unchanged tests and include doctests. No valid implementation-only verbatim reversal was established.
